Cc: legal@cumulus-tech.com
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MPO activation gating — segmented billing + evidence ask

Hey Markus / Vanessa,

Quick context: Cumulus is moving forward with the Private Offer but our finance and legal teams have two gating items before we can sign: 1) segmented billing per business unit (we need separate invoices per AWS account), and 2) an evidence package that proves data handling boundaries (SOC2 summary + customer-data flow).

Can Redwood support per-account invoicing for activation? Also attaching a short checklist of what legal needs — can you confirm what you can provide and expected turnaround? We have a target execution window: Week of Sept 13.

Thanks — Lina
Procurement Ops | Cumulus Tech

Attachment: MPO-evidence-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@cumulus-tech.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MPO activation gating — segmented billing + evidence ask

Lina — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. Short answers up front: yes, segmented billing is supported via our activation mapping to multiple billing profiles; and we can assemble an evidence pack (SOC2 summary + artifact list). A few follow-ups to close on scope: 

- Billing: which AWS account IDs must map to separate invoices? If there are >5 accounts we may need to use our multi-account activation flow (standard, fine to do).
- Evidence: legal asked for (A) SOC2 summary PDF, (B) data flow diagram for S3/DB access, (C) brief note on retention policies and KV-cache behavior (to confirm no customer data persist beyond session).

I'm looping in Rishi (security/compliance) and Grace (activation ops) to confirm delivery dates. If Sept 13 is the execution target, we should have the pack and billing mapping confirmed by Sept 8.

Action items: Rishi — can you own the evidence pack? Grace — can you confirm whether the billing mapping requires an internal billing ticket or can be done in our activation UI?

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Marketplace Sales | Redwood Inference

Markus — taking this. Quick status:

- SOC2 summary: we have a one-pager and a short FAQ we can share (will attach).
- Dataflow diagram: DevSecOps will produce a sanitized diagram showing service boundaries (no customer PII in diagrams).
- Retention/KV-cache note: prepared a 2-paragraph explainer on how our runtime handles transient caches and the retention default; can add explicit language for enterprise commitments.

Billing note for Grace: our activation ops supports multi-account invoice grouping by creating separate billing profiles per AWS account ID. That is a manual step in the portal for now; ops can do the activation if the customer provides account IDs and a payer contact. If Cumulus wants automated mapping across 12 accounts we should plan a two-day ops window.

Deliverables and ETA: SOC2 summary + FAQ (by 9/6), sanitized dataflow diagram (by 9/7), retention note (by 9/6). I recommend we push for a 9/8 internal review so Markus/Vanessa can approve before sending to Cumulus.

-Rishi
